name: Berserker
desc: Berserker is one of the subclasses of Barbarian. These Barbarians are more specialized in using their anger to gain more abilities while raging in combat.

features.d: Your bloodthirst transforms your rage, making it stronger.
Your Rage turns into a frenzy! You gain Frenzied Strike and Enraged Throw. You can also make an Improvised Melee Weapon attack as a bonus action.
As a bonus action, make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
Pick up an item or creature and throw it at a target, dealing additional damage and knocking it Prone.
Your rage becomes all-consuming, repelling outside influence. While Frenzied, you can't be Charmed or Frightened, and Calm Emotions no longer ends your rage.
Menace an enemy and instil a terrible Fear within them.

name: Giant
desc: Path of Giants is one of the subclasses of Barbarian. They can grow in size while raging and kick and throw other creatures. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: Enter a Rage and increase in size. Your Rage damage bonus is doubled on Throw attacks.
Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.
Gain Advantage on Intimidation and Performance Checks.
Try to kick a target away. Your chances depend on your Athletics, and are higher if you're hidden or invisible.

Channel primordial might into your weapon. Until the end of your Rage, your weapon will deal 1d6 additional Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, and gain the Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand.
Throw a creature or object that is Medium-sized or smaller.

name: Wild Magic
desc: Wild Magic is one of the subclasses of barbarian. These barbarians manifest otherworldy magic to bolster their martial abilities.

features.d: Enter a Rage that releases all the magic roiling inside you, causing a random magical effect.
Anyone within range adds a 1d4 bonus to Saving throws. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
You or an ally receive +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks for 10 turns. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
You or an ally recover a Level 1 Spell Slot. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
You or an ally recover a Level 2 Spell Slot. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
You or an ally recover a Level 3 Spell Slot. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
While Raging, when you take damage or fail a Saving Throw, you trigger another Wild Magic effect. This replaces your current Wild Magic effect.

name: Wildheart
desc: Wildheart is one of the Subclasses of Barbarian. These Barbarians are attuned with nature and the beasts that live in it. Their rages resemble the animals that inspired them.

features.d: Gain the ability to comprehend and communicate with beasts. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

fields.Description: While Raging, you can use Unrelenting Ferocity, and have Resistance to all damage except psychic damage.
While Raging, you can use Diving Strike. Foes also have Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use Dash as a bonus action.
While Raging, you can use Primal Stampede, and your Movement Speed increases by 4.5 m (15 ft).
While Raging, you can use Tiger's Bloodlust, and your jump distance increases by 4.5 m (15 ft).
While Raging, you can use Inciting Howl, and your allies have Advantage on melee Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft) of you.
Your carrying capacity is doubled, and you have Advantage on Strength Checks.
You gain Resistance to fall damage, and throwing Camp Supplies Blinds targets.
Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while standing in water-based surfaces. On slippery surfaces, you also have Advantage on Saving Throws against being knocked prone.
You see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft), and gain Advantage on Perception Checks.
Grant yourself and nearby allies (18 m (60 ft)) +1.5 m (5 ft) permanent movement speed.
If you're Poisoned, Frightened or Charmed at the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to begin Raging without expending a Rage Charge.
Dashing grants you temporary hit points equal to twice your barbarian level.
You add an additional Strength modifier to Attack Rolls against Bleeding or Poisoned targets, and gain proficiency in Survival.
You and nearby allies (18 m (60 ft)) add your Dexterity modifier as a bonus to your Stealth Checks.
When you attack a Bleeding or Poisoned target, you inflict Maim on them.

name: College of Glamour
desc: College of Glamour is one of the subclasses of Bard. It can inspire multiple allies simultaneously with temporary hit points and influence enemies. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: Imbue 2 allies with your vigour and grant them 5 temporary hit points. If they're hit with a melee attack, the attacker becomes Charmed.
Command a creature to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground or drop its weapon. Targets that are Charmed automatically fail their Saving Throw. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Bonus increases to 8 temporary hit points.
Bonus increases to 11 temporary hit points.

desc: College of Lore is one of the Subclasses of Bard. These Bards gain the ability to hinder their foes with their performances, 3 more Skill Proficiencies, and additional pick of Magical Secrets spells.

features.d: The target receives a -1d6 penalty to Attack Rolls, Ability Checks or damage dealt.
Learn 2 non-Bard Spells from the Magical Secrets list of level 3 or lower.

name: Circle of the Moon
desc: Circle of the Moon is one of the subclasses of Druid. These Druids are more specialized in Wild Shaping into various creatures to attack enemies or support allies in combat. They also have the ability to regain Hit Points while Wild Shaped.

features.d: Expend spell slots to regain Hit Points while wild shaped. You regain 1d8 hit points per spell slot level.

Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.

Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier Psychic damage.
Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier Radiant damage.
Regain half your Ki Points and enter a temporary state of Wholeness where you regain Ki Points and have an extra Bonus Action. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Hit a creature with your bare fists, making the ki in its body Resonate with yours.
Hit a creature with your bare fists, making the ki in its body Resonate with yours.
Detonate the ki of a creature Resonating with you, hitting the creature and all creatures other than party members and summoned creatures within 5 m / 17 ft of it. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
Long Rests surround you with an aura of peace, granting you Sanctuary permanently until you attack.

name: Oath of Devotion
desc: Oath of Devotion is one of the subclasses of Paladin. These Paladins gain abilities that aid them in protecting the weak, dispelling falsehoods, and defeating fiends and undead.

features.d: Oath of Devotion paladins abide by the following tenets: Courage. Stride dauntlessly into action. Compassion. Show clemency when prudent, and lend your arm to those in need. Duty. Tend your responsibilities, obey just laws, and support those entrusted to your care.
Call upon your Oath to grant a vengeful aura that deals 1d4 Radiant damage to anyone who hits them with a melee attack.
Turn your weapon into a Sacred Weapon. It has a higher chance of hitting, and emits a bright light.
Turn nearby undead and fiends. They are forced to flee and cannot come close to you.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Protection from Evil and Good Sanctuary
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Lesser Restoration Silence
You and any nearby allies can't be Charmed. The aura disappears if you fall unconscious.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Remove Curse Beacon of Hope

name: Oath of the Ancients
desc: Oath of the Ancients is one of the subclasses of Paladin. These Paladins have a deep connection with the natural world and the light within it.

features.d: Oath of the Ancients paladins abide by the following tenets: Kindle the Light. Through your acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair. Shelter the Light. Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren. Preserve Your Own Light. Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can’t preserve it in the world. Be the Light. Be a glorious beacon for all who live in despair. Let the light of your joy and courage shine forth in all your deeds.
Heal yourself and all nearby allies. Regain the same amount the next turn.
Invoke primaeval forces to restrain an enemy.
Channel your Oath using ancient words to Turn nearby fey and fiends.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Speak with Animals Ensnaring Strike
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Misty Step Moonbeam
You and any nearby allies take only half the damage from spells.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Protection from Energy Plant Growth

name: Oath of the Crown
desc: Oath of the Crown is one of the subclasses of Paladin. It focuses on protecting allies by healing them and redirecting attacks. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: Oath of the Crown paladins abide by the following tenets: Law. Uphold civilisation and order. Loyalty. Your word is your bond; without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless. Responsibility. Deal with the consequences of your actions, and fulfil your duties and obligations.
Target yourself or an ally to additionally grant the target's proficiency bonus to their Attack Rolls.
Challenge the enemies around you, compelling them to attack only you. Any attacks they might make against other targets have Disadvantage.
Shout out and heal all nearby non-enemy creatures.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Command Compelled Duel
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Warding Bond Spiritual Weapon

When an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft) of you takes damage, you can use your Reaction to magically substitute your own health for your ally's, healing them by 2 × (Paladin level) Hit Points at the cost of taking 2 × (Paladin level) Radiant damage yourself.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Spirit Guardians Crusader's Mantle

name: Oath of Vengeance
desc: Oath of Vengeance is one of the subclasses of Paladin that focuses on righting wrongs and delivering justice, usually by any means necessary.

features.d: Oath of Vengeance paladins abide by the following tenets: Fight the Greater Evil. Exerting your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given instance, and fight for it. No Mercy for the Wicked. Chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever.
You or an ally's weapon attacks deal an additional Charisma modifier Radiant damage and can Daze enemies for 1 turn.
Frighten an enemy. They have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls, and they cannot move.
Gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against an enemy.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Bane Hunter's Mark
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Misty Step Hold Person
If you hit an enemy with an Opportunity Attack, your movement speed increases by 4.5 m (15 ft) on your next turn.
You gain additional spells from your oath. They are Always Prepared. Haste Protection from Energy

name: Oathbreaker
desc: Oathbreaker is one of the subclasses of Paladin. These Paladins draw power from the darkness within to destroy their foes.

features.d: Steep an enemy in the darkness that churns within you. The target takes 1d4 + Charisma Modifier Necrotic damage each turn and Attack Rolls against it have Advantage.
Use the power of your Oath to gain control over an undead creature. The undead will follow you around and attack your enemies.
Let your darkest emotions burst forth as a menacing pulse to Frighten nearby enemies.
You gain additional spells from the darkness within. They are Always Prepared. Hellish Rebuke Inflict Wounds
You gain additional spells from the darkness within. They are Always Prepared. Crown of Madness Darkness
You and any nearby fiends and undead gain additional damage to melee weapon attacks equal to your Charisma Modifier.
You gain additional spells from the darkness within. They are Always Prepared. Bestow Curse Animate Dead

name: Beast Master
desc: Beast Master is one of the subclasses of Ranger. These Rangers are able to summon an animal companion to aid them in combat and exploration. The companions also gain new features and abilities as the Ranger level increases.

features.d: Gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and fights alongside you. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Your Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to Armour Class and damage equal to its Proficiency Bonus.
Your summoned companions can now Dash, Disengage, and Help as a Bonus Action.
Grants all your companions an extra attack.

name: Gloom Stalker
desc: Gloom Stalker is a subclass of Ranger. Gloom Stalkers specialize in taking out foes swiftly and ruthlessly from the shadows, gaining damage bonuses and increased movement speed.

features.d: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).

You specialise in taking out foes swiftly and ruthlessly. You gain a +3 bonus to Initiative. On the first turn of combat, your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft), and you can also make an extra weapon attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage
On the first turn of each combat, ambush a target with an additional swift and precise attack. ( Recharge: Per combat.)
On the first turn of each combat, ambush a target with an additional swift and precise attack. ( Recharge: Per combat.)
Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.
You gain Proficiency in Wisdom and Intelligence Saving Throws.
When you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another one for free.

name: Hunter
desc: Hunter is one of the subclasses of Ranger. These Rangers are more specialized in dealing high damage to enemies, using Spellcasting, and area of effect and utility attacks to hunt down their prey.

features.d: You specialize in fighting specific threats. Choose one of the following features:
Faced with enemies that can instill dread, attack in frenzied bursts, and swarm in great numbers, rangers inevitably develop cunning methods of defence. Choose 1 of the following:
Fire a cascade of magical broadheads and bodkin arrows upon nearby foes.
Strike out at all nearby foes, making separate Attack Rolls against each target.

fields.Description: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
Advantage on Saving Throws against being Frightened.
When an enemy attacks you, they suffer -4 penalty to additional Attack Rolls against you until start of their next turn.

name: Swarmkeeper
desc: Swarmkeeper is one of the subclasses of Ranger. They command swarms of fey creatures to assist them in battle. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: Your swarm deals additional damage to creatures marked by Hunter's Mark
Choose the swarm of nature spirits you've formed a bond with. You can change your swarm whenever you level up. An ability for the chosen swarm can be used once per round after landing an attack.

You gain a swarm of jellyfish that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Lightning damage, Shock your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.

You gain a swarm of moths that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Psychic damage, Blind your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.

You gain a swarm of bees that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Piercing damage, push the enemy away from you, or teleport you to a safer location.
Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Lightning damage.
Use your swarm to Teleport you to a new location.
Use your swarm Shock your target.
Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Psychic damage.
Use your swarm to Teleport you to a new location.
Use your swarm to Blind your target.
Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Piercing damage.
Use your swarm to Teleport you to a new location.
Use your swarm to push your target back 5 m (17 ft)
You gain the following spells. They are Always Prepared. Mage Hand Faerie Fire
You gain the following spell. It is Always Prepared. Web
Used to cast Writhing Tide. Replenished on a Long Rest.
Condense part of your swarm into a mass that lifts you up. Gain a flying speed of 9 m (30 ft) and become unaffected by surface effects.
One additional use of Writhing Tide.
You gain the following spell. It is Always Prepared. Gaseous Form

Your swarm has grown stronger. The swarm's regular attack now deals 1d8 damage, its special attack has one additional feature, and teleporting with your swarm now also increases your Armour Class for the rest of the round.
Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Lightning damage.
Use your swarm to Teleport to a new location within 5 m (17 ft) and gain a temporary +2 bonus to your Armour Class.

features.n: Cloud of Jellyfish: Mighty Shocking Sting
features.d: Use your swarm to Shock and Disarm your target.
Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Psychic damage.
Use your swarm to Teleport you to a new location within 5 m (17 ft) and gain a temporary +2 bonus to your Armour Class.

features.n: Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm
features.d: Use your swarm to Blind and Slow your target.
Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 Piercing damage.
Use your swarm to Teleport you to a new location.
Use your swarm to push your target back 5 m (17 ft) and knock them Prone.

name: Arcane Trickster
desc: Arcane Trickster is a subclass of Rogue. These Rogues are capable of spellcasting (from the Wizard spell list ) and use their spells to attack enemies or support allies in combat. Arcane Tricksters use Intelligence as their spellcasting...

features.d: When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is invisible and permanent.
Intelligence Level 1 Spell Slots Unlocked: 2 You gain two Level 1 Spell Slots.
Choose 2 Cantrips from the Wizard spell list.
Arcane Trickster Spells are Always Prepared.
Choose 2 Spells from the Wizard spell list (schools of Enchantment or Illusion only) up to Level 1. These spells are Always Prepared.
Level 1 Spell Slots Unlocked: 3 You gain an additional Level 1 Spell Slot.
Choose 1 Spell from the Arcane Trickster spell list (schools of Enchantment or Illusion only). This spell is Always Prepared.
Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.
Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.
Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.
Level 1 Spell Slots Unlocked: 4 You gain an additional Level 1 Spell Slot.
You gain two Level 2 Spell Slots.
Choose 1 Spell from the Wizard spell list (schools of Enchantment or Illusion only). This spell is Always Prepared.

features.n: New Level 2 Enchantment and Illusion spells available

features.d: Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.
Choose 1 Spell from the Wizard spell list (any spell school) up to Level 2. This spell is Always Prepared.
Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.
While you are Hiding, your targets have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Spells.
Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.
6 Level 1 Spell Slots Unlocked: 6 You gain two additional Level 1 Spell Slots.
Choose 1 Cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
Choose 1 Spell from the Wizard spell list (schools of Enchantment or Illusion only). This spell is Always Prepared.
Choose 1 Spell from the Wizard spell list (schools of Enchantment or Illusion only). This spell is Always Prepared.
Choose 1 known spell and replace it with another Spell from the full Wizard spell list. The replacement spell must still be of a level for which the Arcane Trickster has spell slots.

name: Assassin
desc: Assassin is a subclass of Rogue. It's focused on dealing higher and more reliable damage to enemies at the start of battle, especially if you can surprise them.

features.d: Quick as an alley cat in a rain-dark city, you immediately restore your Action and Bonus Action at the start of combat
Any successful Attack Roll against a Surprised creature is a Critical Hit.
You are deadliest against unprepared enemies. In combat, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.
Adopt a new identity, changing your appearance.

name: Swashbuckler
desc: Swashbuckler is one of the subclasses of Rogue. Unlike other rogues, they focus on fighting enemies head-to-head in single combat. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: If you make a melee attack against a target, that target can't make Opportunity Attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

You gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls. This scales with your rogue level. You no longer need Advantage to trigger Sneak Attack as long as you are within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target and don't have Disadvantage. [ See: Bugs ]

Deal extra damage to a foe you have Advantage against. You can also use this attack without Advantage if there are no other combatants within 2 m (7 ft) of the target, or if you have an ally within that range. ( Recharge: Per turn.)

Deal extra damage to a foe you have Advantage against. You can also use this attack without Advantage if there are no other combatants within 2 m (7 ft) of the target, or if you have an ally within that range. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
Learn the following Dirty Tricks.

features.n: Dirty Trick: Flick o' the Wrist
features.d: Flick your weapon at a target and possibly Disarm them.
Toss a handful of sand at your enemy and possibly Blind them.
Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll.
Roll a Persuasion check to beguile a humanoid, who must contest it with an Insight check. Enemies who fail gain Panache: Disadvantage; others who fail become Charmed.

name: Thief
desc: Thief is a subclass of Rogue. Most notably, its Fast Hands passive grants a second Bonus Action. Together with the cunning actions the rogue gains at level 2, this subclass allows for exceptional mobility and enhanced versatility.

features.d: You gain an extra Bonus Action, which you can use with any of your existing Bonus Actions.
You've mastered the art of falling and gain Resistance to Falling damage.
Blend into the environment so completely that you become Invisible. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Draconic Bloodline
desc: Draconic Bloodline is one of the subclasses of Sorcerer. These Sorcerers are harder to hit than their counterparts. They also have the ability to gain resistance and deal more damage with certain types of damage based on their bloodline.

features.d: Dragon-like scales cover parts of your skin. When you aren't wearing armour, your base Armour Class is 13.
Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each Sorcerer level.
When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you add your Charisma Modifier to the damage.
When you cast a spell that deals damage matching your draconic ancestry, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to gain Resistance to that damage type.
Fly to a target position

fields.Description: Fire is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Acid is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Lightning is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Cold is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Poison is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Fire is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Cold is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Lightning is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Acid is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.
Fire is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor.

name: Shadow Magic
desc: Shadow Magic is one of the subclasses of Sorcerer. They command a shadowy mastiff which can attack and curse enemies. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: You can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).
After reaching 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 instead of becoming downed.
Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.
Create a dark shroud that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.
Summon forth a creature of darkness. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Teleport into the shadows. The next spell you cast that turn will benefit from Distant Spell without costing any Sorcery Points.

name: Storm Sorcery
desc: Storm Sorcery is one of the Subclasses of Sorcerer. They are extremely mobile, being able to fly after each spell they cast, making it safer for them to wade into melee. As they grow in power they can make their spells generate small dam...

features.d: After you cast a Level 1 Spell or higher you can Fly as a Bonus Action up to 9 m (30 ft) until the end of your turn without receiving Opportunity Attacks.

When you cast a Spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Lightning or Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer Level / 2) Lightning or (Sorcerer Level / 2) Thunder.
When you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Lightning damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer level / 2) Lightning.
When you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer level / 2) Thunder.
You are Resistant to Lightning and Thunder damage
You gain additional spells from your subclass. Thunderwave Create or Destroy Water Gust of Wind Sleet Storm Call Lightning
When struck by a melee attack, you may deal Lightning damage to the attacker and possibly push them back.

name: Wild Magic
desc: Wild Magic is one of the Subclasses of Sorcerer. These Sorcerers are capable of using the chaos of their magic to unleash various unexpected effects that can be helpful or chaotic. They also have the ability to gain Advantage on rolls, i...

features.d: Unruly magic sparks and fizzes through your veins. Each time you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher, your magic might surge and trigger a random magical effect.
Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw. Increased chance of Wild Magic surge afterwards.

When a creature you can see makes an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or a Saving Throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 Sorcery Points to roll 1d4, applying the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll.
Induce a Wild Magic Surge on the nearby spellcaster.

name: The Archfey
desc: The Archfey is one of the subclasses of Warlock. Graced by a lady or lord of the fey, these warlocks are imbued with all the sumptuous and fearsome qualities of their patron's extraordinary realm.

features.d: Charm or Frighten nearby foes with the feywild's beguiling, disturbing magics. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
1st Level Spells Faerie Fire Sleep
2nd Level Spells Calm Emotions Phantasmal Force
3rd Level Spells Blink Plant Growth
Upon taking damage, become Invisible. On your next turn, you can cast Misty Step, though this will break your invisibility.
4th Level Spells Dominate Beast Greater Invisibility
5th Level Spells Dominate Person Seeming
You have built stoic barriers in your heart and mind, and cannot be Charmed.

name: The Fiend
desc: The Fiend is one of the subclasses of Warlock. These Warlocks are servants of chaotic and destructive beings such as demons or devils and traded their souls to these dark forces in exchange for power. They also have the ability to gain a...

features.d: Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this gift from your patron grants you Charisma modifier + Warlock level temporary hit points.
1st Level Spells Burning Hands Command
2nd Level Spells Blindness Scorching Ray
3rd Level Spells Fireball Stinking Cloud
Call on your patron to change your fate and add a 1d10 to an Ability Check.
4th Level Spells Wall of Fire Fire Shield
5th Level Spells Cone of Cold Flame Strike
Choose a damage type and become Resistant to it. You can pick a new damage type each Short Rest. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

name: The Great Old One
desc: The Great Old One is one of the subclasses of Warlock. These Warlocks are acolytes of eldritch entities that are incomprehensible to regular mortals. They are given the ability to channel magic through pacts with these ancient beings in...

features.d: When you land a Critical Hit against a creature, that creature and any nearby enemies must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened until the end of their next turn.
1st Level Spells Dissonant Whispers Tasha's Hideous Laughter
2nd Level Spells Detect Thoughts Phantasmal Force
3rd Level Spells Bestow Curse Slow
Impose Disadvantage on an Attack Roll against you. If the attack misses, you gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll against the attacker for 1 turn.
4th Level Spells Dominate Beast Evard's Black Tentacles
5th Level Spells Dominate Person Telekinesis
An elder being shields your brain. You gain Resistance to Psychic damage.
Your patron doesn't appreciate attempts to attack your mind. When you take Psychic damage, your attacker takes the same damage.

name: The Hexblade
desc: Hexblade is one of the subclasses of Warlock. They can curse enemies with their hexed weapons and raise the souls of defeated enemies as spectres. Released as part of Patch 8 on April 15, 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: You gain proficiency with Medium armour, Shields, and Martial weapons. You gain Bind Hexed Weapon, which lets you use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity when attacking with weapons that you are proficient with.

Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already. When you attack with this weapon, there is a chance [ See Notes ] that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.

Curse a target. Your damage rolls against the target gain a bonus equal to your Proficiency bonus. The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking the target is also reduced by 1. If the target dies, you regain Warlock level + Charisma modifier hit points. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
1st Level Spells Shield Wrathful Smite
2nd Level Spells Blur Branding Smite
3rd Level Spells Blink Elemental Weapon

Raise an Accursed Spectre from the soul of a fallen cursed target to fight by your side. The size of the fallen creature will determine whether you raise a Feeble Spectre, Mundane Spectre, or Primordial Spectre. Doesn't work with constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, or undead.
4th Level Spells Phantasmal Killer Staggering Smite Dominate Beast [ See: Bugs ] Greater Invisibility [ See: Bugs ]
5th Level Spells Banishing Smite Cone of Cold
When a creature you cursed with Hexblade's Curse attacks you, potentially nullify the attack. This has a 50% chance of succeeding.

name: Abjuration School
desc: Abjuration School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards are specialized in magic that can protect themselves and allies from harm. They also have the ability to reduce the amount of damage dealt to them on subsequent turns wh...

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Abjuration spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
The residual magic of your spells forms a ward around you that protects you from harm.
When a nearby ally takes damage, you can use your Arcane Ward to reduce the damage equal to its charges and then lose 1 charge.
Each time you take a Short Rest, the intensity of your Arcane Ward increases by an amount equal to your wizard level.

name: Bladesinging
desc: Bladesinger is one of the subclasses of Wizard. It uses an elegant combination of sword and spell to defeat enemies. Released as part of Patch 8 in 2025. [ url 1 ]

features.d: Used to cast Bladesong. Replenished on a Long Rest. Bladesinging is not possible in Medium or Heavy armor, even if proficient; you will receive the "Bladesong Impeded" Condition while wearing them.
Invoke the Bladesong. You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class and your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft). You also gain Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2 to Constitution Saving Throws.
You gain proficiency with Light armour and in the Performance skill. You also gain proficiency with Daggers, Longswords, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, and Sickles.
Gain an additional use of Bladesong.
Bonus to AC and Constitution Saving Throws increases to +3.
You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack.
Gain an additional use of Bladesong.
Bonus to AC and Constitution Saving Throws increases to +4.
When you take damage during your Bladesong, you can expend a spell slot to subtract 5 damage per spell slot.

name: Conjuration School
desc: Conjuration School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards specialize in summoning the elements and moving themselves and others from one place to another.

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Conjuration spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
Call forth rain. It extinguishes exposed flames and forms a Water surface. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Teleport to a nearby, unoccupied space, or swap places with an ally. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Damage taken while you are Concentrating on a Conjuration spell will not break your Concentration.

name: Divination School
desc: Divination School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards specialize in fates and knowledge. They can manipulate random outcomes and see the unseen.

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Divination spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.

Your dreams grant you glimpses that let you influence the future. After each Long Rest, the user gains two random Portent Dice. During the day, they can use their reaction to change the die of an Attack Roll or Saving Throw rolled near them to one of their Portent Dice. Each Portent Die can only be used once; unused Portent Dice are lost at the end of the day.
You gain an additional Portent Die. When taking a Short Rest you receive a set of Prophecies. Complete them to regain missing Portent Dice.
You gain the ability to see in the dark out to a range of 24 m (80 ft) ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Enchantment School
desc: Enchantment School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards specialize in controlling and befuddling others.

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Enchantment spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
Charm and Incapacitates a creature. It cannot attack you. It cannot act. ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Charm an enemy attacking you. They will attack a new target if possible.
You know your enchantments inside and out. You can target 2 creatures with Enchantment spells that would normally only target 1 creature.

name: Evocation School
desc: Evocation School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards are specialized in offensive magic that deal large damage to enemies and control the battlefield. They also have the ability to protect their allies from harmful Evocatio...

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Evocation spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
Create pockets of safety within your Evocation spells. Allies automatically succeed their Saving Throws against these spells and take no damage from them.
Your cantrips become harder to evade entirely. When a creature succeeds its Saving Throw against one of your cantrips, it still takes half the cantrip's damage, but suffers no additional effects.
Your grasp of Evocation magic has tightened, and you can add your Intelligence Modifier to damage rolls with any Evocation spells.

name: Illusion School
desc: Illusion School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards are specialized in illusory magic that can hide where they are, detect the invisible, or trick enemies into wasting actions.

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Illusion spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
You can cast Minor Illusion as a bonus action.
Glimpse Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
Interpose an illusory duplicate of yourself between you and an attacker's strike, making them miss their attack.

name: Necromancy School
desc: Necromancy School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards are specialized in powers of death, allowing them to protect themselves from harm and raise undead minions to serve them.

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Necromancy spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
Once per turn, if you kill a creature with a spell, you regain Hit Points equal to twice the Spell Slot level used - thrice if it's a Necromancy spell. Undead and Constructs are unaffected.
You gain the Animate Dead spell, if you didn't have it already
When you use Animate Dead, you can raise an additional corpse.
Creatures created with Animate Dead have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your Proficiency Bonus is added to their damage.
You have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are Resistant to Necrotic damage, and moreover your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.

name: Transmutation School
desc: Transmutation School is one of the subclasses of Wizard. These Wizards become accomplished Alchemists, able to pass benefits to companions. At higher levels they can turn into a bird without using a spell slot.

features.d: Halves the cost to learn Transmutation spells from Scrolls. Learning these spells will only cost 25 gp per spell level.
You brew two Alchemical Solutions instead of one when combining extracts, if you succeed a Difficulty Class 15 Medicine Check.
You can create Transmuter's Stones.
Variants: Transmuter's Stone: Constitution Create a stone that grants the carrier Proficiency in Constitution Saving Throws.
Create a stone that lets the carrier see in the dark out to a range of 18 m (60 ft).
Create a stone that increases the carrier's movement speed by 3 m (10 ft).
Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Acid.
Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Cold.
Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Fire.
Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Lightning.
Create a stone that grants the carrier Resistance to Thunder.
Transform into a blue jay, able to Fly. If the blue jay's hit points drop to 0, the target reverts to its original form with its original hit points.
